package mergecasual

import (
	"crypto/hmac"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/clock"
	"time"
)

// SignedReward 模拟受信任广告平台的已完成回调。密钥由服务端注入，不在请求协议、配置表或 DAO。
// 真实平台须按其签名、订单身份、账号绑定和撤销规则实现适配器，不能相信客户端观看成功布尔值。
type SignedReward struct {
	ID                  string
	PlayerID, ExpiresAt int64
	Kind, MAC           string
}

func rewardMAC(p SignedReward, key string) string {
	h := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte(key))
	fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%d\x00%d\x00%s", p.ID, p.PlayerID, p.ExpiresAt, p.Kind)
	return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
}
func SignReward(p SignedReward, key string) SignedReward { p.MAC = rewardMAC(p, key); return p }

// adIDValid 借鉴 wallet 业务键的写法：1～64 个 ASCII 字母、数字与 - _ :，广告平台的订单号原样当到账键。
func adIDValid(id string) bool {
	if id == "" || len(id) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(id); i++ {
		c := id[i]
		if !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c == '-' || c == '_' || c == ':') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// GrantAd 核对广告回调并记到账回执，返回要经 stamina 发的体力点数；同一个广告订单号的重放返回 0（不再发）。
// 每日次数借鉴 checkin：按业务日（clock.BusinessDay，部署配置的业务时区与重置时刻）切分，不按 UTC 毫秒整除。
// 体力是否放得下由 stamina 决定（发到硬顶为止），handler 要求实际发足，否则整笔拒绝。
func (s *State) GrantAd(p SignedReward, key string, ownerID int64, epoch uint64, now int64) (int64, error) {
	if epoch != s.Epoch || len(key) < 32 || !adIDValid(p.ID) || p.PlayerID != ownerID || p.Kind != "energy" {
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	actual, e := hex.DecodeString(p.MAC)
	expected, _ := hex.DecodeString(rewardMAC(p, key))
	if e != nil || !hmac.Equal(actual, expected) {
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(encode(p)))
	identity := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	for _, r := range s.Ads {
		if r.ID == p.ID {
			if r.Digest != identity {
				return 0, ErrRule
			}
			return 0, nil
		}
	}
	if len(s.Ads) >= LedgerLimit || !validTime(p.ExpiresAt) || now >= p.ExpiresAt || s.Revision >= uint64(ValueLimit) {
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	if err := s.Recover(now); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	day := int64(clock.BusinessDay(time.UnixMilli(now)))
	count := 0
	for _, r := range s.Ads {
		if r.Day == day {
			count++
		}
	}
	if count >= 3 {
		return 0, ErrRule
	}
	s.Ads = append(s.Ads, AdReceipt{p.ID, identity, day})
	s.Revision++
	s.Sale = Sale{}
	return s.Rules.AdEnergy, nil
}
